defective_pattern: Inserting English technical terms or acronyms inline within Persian academic text.
why_defective: Violates formal Persian scholarly writing norms requiring unified RTL script. Inline English disrupts reading flow and formatting.
observed_symptoms: Latin script terminology interspersed with Persian words.
Inconsistent visual presentation of key theoretical concepts.
corrective_remedy: Use standard Persian translations for technical terms. Provide the original English term or acronym as a footnote upon its first occurrence.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Scanning for Latin script substrings [A-Za-z] functioning as standalone technical jargon within RTL blocks.
